attempted_claim: Let ex_3^{lin}(n,C_5) be the maximum edges in an n-vertex 3-uniform linear hypergraph with no Berge 5-cycle. Ergemlidze-Gyori-Methuku proved ex_3^{lin}(n,C_5) = n^{3/2}/(3 sqrt(3)) + O(n) via Construction H. (a) Stability: for every epsilon>0 there exist delta>0, n0 such that any n>=n0 extremal-near hypergraph with >= (1-delta) n^{3/2}/(3 sqrt(3)) edges is within epsilon n^{3/2} edge-edits of a balanced member of Construction H. (b) Exact classification: determine ex_3^{lin}(n,C_5) exactly for all large n and characterize all extremal hypergraphs, via flag-algebra stability plus linearity-preserving symmetrization. Parts (a) and (b) are distinct; no equivalence assumed.
decisive_failure: The investigation was confined to the admitted target route of flag-algebra stability plus linearity-preserving symmetrization for Berge-C5-free linear 3-graphs. It did not develop the missing sparse flag-algebra machinery or a constrained symmetrization theory, and the verified artifacts are calibrations and an elementary counterexample rather than progress toward the full stability and exact-classification claims.
